_comment: SHIPPED default witness-quorum policy (Lane O / O4). OPERATOR-ACTIVATED, demote-only: activate by setting CRUCIBLE_WITNESS_QUORUM_CONFIG to this file's path, or to the sentinel 'default'. Env-unset keeps the quorum DISABLED (byte-identical). A crown-jewel FACT re-firing fewer than quorum_n independent oracle-witness kinds is withheld as a LEAD; it never promotes. Mirrors witness_quorum.default_critical_policy(); tests pin the two together so they cannot drift.
